notes: Private helper parameter registers are selected by VC7 LTCG; C++ declarations give logical arguments.
FrontendInitialized is a provisional semantic name for the byte reset at startup, original 0x04089cb8.
StateFileName intentionally retains 256-byte allocation despite original preview notification passing 260 as maximum path length.
EasterText.h contains original literal text; no original host executable code bytes are embedded.

MainWindowPosition is one POINT aggregate at 0x04089dd4: grouping x/y preserves the original WM_MOVE load/store scheduling. A two-int array also yields matching code, so the exact original C type spelling is inferred.

MainWindowCommand shares one final return and starts its source switch with the netplay branch. Separate typed chat/drop callbacks fold to the same empty stdcall body, preserving two original immediate callback stores.

MainWindowProc uses switch breaks and a common zero return. The column-click branch computes a local order, assigns BrowserSortMode in each if/else branch, then passes that global to LVM_SORTITEMS; this reproduces the original notification register allocation.

The persisted frontend ShowErrors option uses ShowErrorMessages at 0x0406b044. The independent debugger/memory flag ShowErrors at 0x03e64e18 remains exposed through host.ShowErrors; sharing those symbols was a source identity error caught by relocation review and corrected.

compile.byte_comparison: Nine of nine complete blocks match, 11088 bytes including local tables and alignment. Recorded PE relocation operands remain separately classified; zero known target mismatches. This does not establish raw executable equality.

linked_probe.limitations: Relocation-normalized complete block evidence is not executable byte equality. Four frontend setting operands are additionally verified directly against original absolute targets. Remaining operand identities retain independent verifier classifications.

historical_probes.limitations: Relocation-normalized complete block evidence is not executable byte equality. Global/source operand identities remain observations unless separately verified; all nine frontend block shapes and independently known targets now agree.

setting_identity_correction.evidence: ReloadConfiguration assigns the Configuration/ShowErrors INI value to 0x0406b044; original menu toggle, persistence and initialization instructions read/write that same location. CPU error reporting separately checks this setting and the debugger/memory ShowErrors flag.
setting_identity_correction.compiled_delta: Only the four confirmed setting-address operands change across all program sections; all sixteen changed operand bytes now equal the original absolute targets. Other section bytes are unchanged.
